rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for moving air.

example.english: The wind is very strong outside today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ceot1 gaai1 di1 fung1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for winding cord, thread, or a similar object around something or into a coil.

example.english: I wind the rope around the post.
example.traditional: 我將條繩捲住喺支柱上面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 tiu4 sing4 gyun2 zyu6 hai2 zi1 cyu5 soeng6 min6

rows.jyutping: waan1 waan1 kuk1 kuk1 gam2 V
rows.note: Use this when a river, road, vine, or other subject follows a noticeably curving route rather than physically wrapping around something.

example.english: The path tends to wind through the woods.
example.traditional: 條小路彎彎曲曲咁穿過樹林。
example.jyutping: tiu4 siu2 lou6 waan1 waan1 kuk1 kuk1 gam2 cyun1 gwo3 syu6 lam4

rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A cyun2 saai3 hei3
rows.note: Use this colloquial causative construction when exertion or a blow makes someone pant or become breathless.

example.english: Running up this slope can wind me.
example.traditional: 跑上呢段斜路搞到我喘晒氣。
example.jyutping: paau2 soeng5 ni1 dyun6 ce4 lou6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 cyun2 saai3 hei3

rows.note: Use this for the breath or breathing capacity someone lacks when they are out of wind.

example.english: I was out of wind after walking just two steps.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 loeng5 bou6 zau6 mou5 hei3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for intestinal gas or flatulence rather than atmospheric air.

example.english: I had wind all evening after eating beans.
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 dau6 leoi6 seng4 maan5 dou1 jau5 pei3

rows.note: Use this for news or a rumour heard indirectly, as in catching wind of something.

example.english: I caught wind that prices will go up tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我聽到風聲，話聽日會加價。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 fung1 seng1 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 gaa1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for tightening the spring of a clock or other clockwork mechanism.

example.english: You have to wind this old clock for it to run.
example.traditional: 呢隻舊鐘要上鏈先行得。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau6 zung1 jiu3 soeng6 lin6 sin1 haang4 dak1
